title: How to Be Interesting at a Dinner Party
titleZh: 如何在晚宴上变得有趣

sentences.text: According to Jessica Hagy, author of How to Be Interesting, it's not difficult to make yourself interesting at a dinner party.
The first step is to go exploring, if you're out of your comfort zone or if you're wandering into somebody's house for the first time.
So the main thing is just to show up and be adventurous, trying different foods and talking to strangers.

paras.zh: 据《如何变得有趣》一书的作者杰西卡·哈吉所说，在晚宴上让自己变得有趣并不难。第一步是去探索，无论你是走出了自己的舒适区，还是第一次走进某人的房子。所以最重要的事情就是到场，并且勇于冒险，尝试不同的食物，与陌生人交谈。

sentences.text: People love to talk about themselves.
If you can start the conversation with a question other than "What do you do for a living?", you'll be able to get a lot more interesting conversation out of whoever it is you're talking to.
If you ask the question "How did you get here?", it can bring in "I have this old, broken-down vehicle" or "I rode the bus with these crazy people who were laughing at silly jokes in the back."

paras.zh: 人们喜欢谈论自己。如果你能以一个不是"你以什么为生？"的问题来开启对话，你就能从任何与你交谈的人那里引出更有趣的对话。如果你问"你是怎么来的？"这个问题，它可能会引出"我有一辆破旧的旧车"或者"我和那些在后面傻笑的人一起坐的公交车"。这正好打开了对话。

sentences.text: What about that person who has had too much to drink or won't stop talking?
If you can't take their wine away, you should certainly try to take away their soapbox.
If you're the host, you can ask them to help you in the kitchen with something and just remove them from the situation.
Or turn the conversation into a topic where they have little to say.

paras.zh: 那那个喝太多酒或者不停说话的人呢？如果你不能拿走他们的酒，你当然应该试着拿走他们的演讲台。如果你是主人，你可以请他们到厨房帮你做点事情，从而让他们脱离那个情境。或者把话题转向一个他们没什么可说的领域。

sentences.text: And what about that other dinner-party killer: awkward silence?
If you're faced with an awkward silence at a dinner party, the only thing that always gets everyone talking again is to give the host a compliment.
He or she is the person who is feeling the weight of that awkwardness the most.
Just quickly turn around and say, "This cake is extremely delicious and you have to tell me all about it."
So being interesting at a dinner party isn't that hard.

paras.zh: 那另一个晚宴杀手——尴尬的沉默呢？如果你在晚宴上面临尴尬的沉默，唯一能让所有人重新开始交谈的方法就是赞美主人。他或她是最能感受到那种尴尬重压的人。只需迅速转身说："这块蛋糕极其美味，你得跟我好好讲讲。"所以在晚宴上变得有趣并没有那么难。
